title: REQ · History list shows an empty state when the player has no suggestions
summary: Empty message shown when loaded history and entries are both empty
description: Context: an empty history currently renders a blank list. Desired behavior: after listMine resolves with no items and no local entries exist, show 'No suggestions yet this round'. Why: distinguishes empty from loading or broken.
acceptance_criteria: Given listMine resolves with [], when loading ends, then 'No suggestions yet this round' is visible and 'Contributions left: 5' shows
Given the empty state is shown, when the player submits a suggestion, then the empty message disappears and the entry is listed
definition_of_done: Empty state renders only when ready and entries empty
